description: This file contains the MessagePayloadSerializer class responsible for serializing and deserializing message payloads in a messaging system, specifically handling JSON and Base64 encoding/decoding within the Ditto framework.

classes.name: MessagePayloadSerializer
classes.description: A utility class for (de-)serializing message payloads, handling JSON and Base64 payload formats within message objects.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the payload of a Message object into a JSON object, encoding raw payloads as Base64 if necessary.

methods.name: interpretAsJsonValue
methods.description: Interprets a payload string as a JSON value based on the content type.

methods.name: injectMessagePayload
methods.description: Inserts the payload into the message builder, with size validation.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON payload into a message, handling JSON, text, and Base64 encoded data.

methods.name: tryToBase64Decode
methods.description: Attempts to decode a byte array from Base64, falling back to original bytes if decoding fails.
